scope_summary: One generated twin2mc-* Entra application and service principal in the selected tenant, one client secret, and one subscription-scoped thesis-demo-v2 custom-role assignment; request-scoped bootstrap authority is not retained.
rationale: The Phase 8 PoC persists Azure deployment CloudConnections as service-principal client credentials. The Deployer authenticates that principal, reads subscription and location metadata, and inspects its assigned custom role; these three self-inspection actions make that executable boundary explicit without mutating the frozen workload inventory.
limitations: The binding is specific to the PoC client-secret path and does not claim managed-identity or workload-federation support for the deployment CloudConnection.
Microsoft Graph application creation, credential issuance, and cleanup remain request-scoped bootstrap-authority operations and are not granted to the generated deployment principal.
The binding adds only the ARM metadata reads required by the existing Deployer preflight; provider-operation compatibility still requires the supervised setup-only and deploy/destroy gates.
